description: This file is a jQuery plugin implementation for unobtrusive user notifications called jGrowl, version 1.4.5. It defines the plugin's core functions, default settings, and methods for creating, rendering, updating, and shutting down notifications.

methods.name: jGrowl
methods.description: Main function to create a notification on the default container or a specified container.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the notification container and sets up periodic updates.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Removes the notification container and clears update intervals.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Triggers the closing of all notifications in the container.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new notification with specified message and options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Handles the display and animation of individual notifications.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Removes expired notifications and renders new ones from the queue.
